'''Banda''' was a [[Color/Legends|yellow]]-carapaced [[Chiggnash]] criminal who operated on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Wolf" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Banda was contacted by the [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]] [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] attendant [[Shnozitskigante-maximilliana]] with a proposition to rob the incognito [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on Nar Shaddaa, though Shnozitski demanded a fifty-one-percent fee for the information and mistook Banda for fellow Chiggnash [[Riley (Chiggnash)|Riley]]. A deal was struck, and Banda, sporting a [[Squib/Legends|squib]] [[tensor rifle]] and two crossed [[Bandolier/Legends|bandoliers]], cornered the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in one of the moon's back alleys, supported by Riley and a trio each of [[Control Mind (Chiggnash)|mind-controlled]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Gender/Legends|sows]], [[Kyuzo/Legends|Kyuzo]] ''[[go-zeki]]'', and [[Cyborrean rabies|rabid]] [[Frog-dog/Legends|frog-dogs]]. Refusing to give in, Kenobi drew his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and slew the frog-dogs, revealing himself to be a Jedi and subject to the Imperial [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on their [[Jedi Order/Legends|order]]. However, the Chiggnash and their [[warrior drone]]s were then set upon by a pair of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]. Banda and Riley were [[Cho mai/Legends|dismembered and disarmed]] by former [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]] [[Mei (Dark Jedi)|Mei]], who [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Chiggnash as they begged for mercy.<ref name="Wolf" />
